# PerchTV 0.1.19

A stream that drops comes back on its own, on both televisions.

## WHAT CHANGED

- On the Onn: when a channel's connection drops, the television tries again by itself, up to five times with a growing pause between tries, instead of stopping at the first drop. If it still cannot play, it says so, with how many times it tried, and tells the phone. A film that drops comes back where it was. This is what the Samsung set already did.
- On both televisions: before a retry, the previous attempt is fully stopped first, so the television never holds two connections to your provider at once while it recovers.
- On the Onn: a stream the television's own decoder cannot play, or a stream the server refuses, is not retried; those still stop at once and say why.
- On the Samsung set: no change of its own. Both televisions move to 0.1.19 together.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Pairing, casting, play/pause and stop, the skip keys, hold ▲ for 8x on the Samsung set, the Loading screen, the waiting screen that moves and goes dark, the connection check every 45 seconds, and the update check on every start.
